title: Bot match input (v0.5, MVP-22, D35)
description: Input of the bot classification as the gateway runs it for one request, used by the bot-match vectors: a catalogue, what the gateway knows about the request, and the bots.verify switches of schild.yaml. Never stored, never sent anywhere. The result is {bot, category, verification} (see bot-catalogue.schema.json for the rules; contract/bots.Classify). fcrdns_name is the reverse name of the address that resolved forward to the same address (absent: no lookup, lookup failed or not confirmed); the gateway asks the resolver only with bots.verify.fcrdns on.

user_agent.description: Empty when the request had none. Only the first 512 bytes are matched.

options.description: bots.verify of schild.yaml; absent keys take the defaults (ranges true, fcrdns false).
